rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.73979, n_angles=2304, n_det=736, det_spacing=1.285044, sod=595.362, sdd=1086.803, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.05, train_n=400, val_n=214, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_unconstrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.7, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=mayo_ldct_2d, rationale=iter-3 EXPLORATORY: DC-strength lever. hr pinned 0 because calibrated metric is PSNR-floored at LD-FBP 34.08 dB and recon sits below (iter-1 30.32, iter-2 31.99 dB) - a global bias/data-consistency deficit, not a sampling-budget shortfall. iter-2 proved +NFE lifts PSNR (+1.67 dB/doubling) but costs 1098s (near 20-min ceiling), so steps cannot be pushed further in budget. Orthogonal lever: fd_recon_dc_relax 0.5->1.0 (full unconstrained CG-DC update) to pull the WDM-prior recon back onto measured sinogram data and recover PSNR toward the floor, at ~zero added wall cost. Base=iter-1 (8 steps, 416s) to stay safely in 20-min budget while isolating the DC lever from NFE.
